title: ArkLib Solicited Proof: Near-Capacity Proximity-Gap Prime Supply
description: Explicitly solicited proof from the Ethereum Foundation's Verified-zkEVM/ArkLib (Issue #1352). ArkLib's coding-theory construction for failure of Reed–Solomon correlated agreement near capacity (Krachun–Kazanin–Haböck, ePrint 2026/782) is already proved; closing this single open `sorry` (`NearCapacityPrimeSupply c`) completes `exists_rs_epsCa_large_near_capacity` with 0 sorry and standard Lean axioms only.

tasks.title: Prove NearCapacityPrimeSupply c (ArkLib Issue #1352)
tasks.description: Closes the sole remaining `sorry` in `ArkLib/Data/CodingTheory/ProximityGap/CapacityBounds.lean` (`exists_rs_epsCa_large_near_capacity`): for every c > 0, prove there exists β > max(c + 2, 12/5) such that infinitely many K admit a prime p ≡ 1 (mod 2^K) in [(2^K)^β, 2*(2^K)^β].
